title: Fallback default position — a request with no ImagePosition

behaviourChange_DD6.what: backend fallback 0.3/0.3 -> 0.8/0.8, matching the three frontend sites

baselineReading.reason: baseline driver emitted no default-position command

behaviourChange_DD6.note: This is an explicit change to an existing export default, not a silent fix. The before/after boxes are both recorded so the size of the change is reviewable: a still that used to render at 30% of the frame now renders at 80%, which is what the preview has always shown.
